description: Public, read-only search for senior living communities by city, ZIP code, hospital, neighborhood, landmark, or verified coordinates, without a CareOpenly account. Relevant to questions about assisted living, memory care, independent living, 55+ communities, and other care types in or near a place. An exact city or ZIP with no radius uses its city inventory; a landmark search defaults to 15 miles. Results include stable facility IDs, care types, links, and available published prices and reviews.

careCategory.description: Senior living, assisted living, memory care, independent living, or 55+ community type.

destination.description: City, ZIP code, neighborhood, hospital, landmark, or CareOpenly city ID. CareOpenly resolves the place.

latitude.description: Optional verified latitude for a nearby search.

longitude.description: Optional verified longitude for the same nearby search.

radiusMiles.description: Nearby radius in miles. An omitted radius uses exact city inventory for cities and ZIPs, and 15 miles for other places.

name: search_facilities
title: Search senior living communities
